clusters.headline: Three Senior PSI Officials Resign To Focus On Governmental Duties
aiSummaryBullets: Three prominent party officials have formally submitted their resignations from the Indonesian Solidarity Party.
The officials cited their focus on executing ministerial and governmental duties assigned by President Prabowo Subianto as the primary reason for leaving.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Officials Refute Involvement In Presidential Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: Interior Minister Tito Karnavian denied rumors of a travel ban related to the illegal wiretapping investigation, labeling the claims as false.
Bahlil Lahadalia stated his intention to pursue legal action against allegations connecting him to the wiretapping activities.

clusters.headline: Funeral Arrangements Announced For Senior Politician Panda Nababan
aiSummaryBullets: Panda Nababan, a prominent senior politician and journalist, passed away on November 9, 2026, due to leukemia.
His burial is scheduled for November 12, 2026, in Siborong-borong, North Tapanuli, North Sumatra, following traditional Batak funeral rites.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Discusses State Leakage With Former Chiefs
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto held a meeting with ten former National Police chiefs at his residence in Hambalang.
Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian stated that discussions focused on addressing state leakage and national security concerns.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Faces Protests
aiSummaryBullets: Demonstrators gathered at the Vice Presidential Palace to demand Gibran Rakabuming Raka resign over certificate disputes.
The Vice Presidential Secretariat offered dialogue, but protesters insisted on a direct meeting with the Vice President.

clusters.headline: Police Investigation Continues Into Jakarta Mosque Morning Attack
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement has detained a suspect and seized items including an axe and gasoline used during the mosque assault.
The suspect faces formal charges and potential imprisonment of up to nine years as police evaluate their mental health status.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo To Confer National Hero Titles To Eighteen Figures
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo is set to lead a ceremony at the State Palace on November 10 to confer national hero titles.
A total of 18 candidates have been proposed for the honor, including the late RM Margono Djojohadikusumo.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Disaster Agency Reviews Helicopter Safety After Crashes
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia's National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) is reviewing water bombing operational procedures following two helicopter crashes in Kalimantan.
The most recent incident in the Barito River resulted in the death of a crew member, whose body has been returned to Jakarta.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Government Establishes Working Group For Human Rights
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Law and Human Rights has formed a cross-institutional working group to address 13 cases of alleged severe human rights violations.
The initiative is led by Otto Hasibuan, with Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra stating the group will not interfere with independent institutions.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Authorities Investigate Former Police Chief Listyo Sigit
aiSummaryBullets: Former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit and three generals have been detained by Bareskrim Polri for allegedly wiretapping President Prabowo.
The Attorney General's Office is investigating potential connections between Listyo Sigit and nickel businessman Arif Kurniawan regarding illegal mining activities.
